findings.message: Plain HTTP is allowed to every host
findings.fix: Remove cleartextTrafficPermitted from <base-config>, or allow plain HTTP only for the hosts that need it with a <domain-config>.

findings.message: Trusts user-installed CA certificates: anyone who adds one to their phone can read the app's HTTPS traffic
findings.fix: Move <certificates src="user"/> into <debug-overrides>, which only applies to debuggable builds.

findings.message: Plain HTTP is allowed to every host on Android 6 and older (Android 7+ follows the network security config instead)
findings.fix: Remove usesCleartextTraffic, or allow HTTP only for specific hosts with a network security config.
